page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. No margin notes. The text runs from the top of the page to the catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Quòd Palamedes falsa ejus criminatione oc-cisus:
Quòd Nestor ab eo in acie desertus:
Quòd si quid utile gessit, non solus, sed à Dio-mede adjutus gesserit:
main_text.head: Argumentum II. à pondere & præstantia armorum Achillis.
main_text.p: 1. quòd sint majora, quàm ut corpusculo adversarii conveniant.
II. quòd sint ei nocitura potiùs quàm profutura, impediendo hominem timidum in fuga: & illiciendo hostem ad prædam.
Conclusio abrupta: Omissis verbis arma mittē-da in medios hostes, & iis ornādum, qui retulerit.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XVIII.

head.i: Paraphrasis Orationis contrariæ Vlyssis Petentis sibi, non Aiaci, arma Achillis decerni.

main_text.p: EXord. habeat πάθῳ[?] de Achillis fato: quod malit eum superstitem esse, quam de armis ejus contendere.
Propositio subiiciatur per adversat: habeatque elevationem argumenti primarii Aiacis, quod arma debeantur vel hæredi vel præstantiori, per inversionem διαλλακτικῶς[?].
Si hæredi, non Aiaci: sed Peleo patri, Pyrrho filio: Teucro patrueli:

page.notes: The Greek word after "habeat" (printed πάθ with a final symbol) and the Greek word in the inversion phrase are hard to read at this resolution; both are marked [?]. The drop cap "E" of "Exord." is joined to the first word as "EXord." Dark scan edges and the book's binding are not transcribed. The catchword "no non" is at the lower right and is read from the scan with some doubt.
